verses.ar: وَعَادَ أَيُّوبُ يَنْطِقُ بِمَثَلِهِ فَقَالَ:
verses.kjv: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,
verses.web: Job again took up his parable, and said,
verses.he: וַיֹּ֣סֶף אִ֭יֹּוב שְׂאֵ֥ת מְשָׁלֹ֗ו וַיֹּאמַֽר׃

verses.ar: «حَيٌّ هُوَ ٱللهُ ٱلَّذِي نَزَعَ حَقِّي، وَٱلْقَدِيرُ ٱلَّذِي أَمَرَّ نَفْسِي،
verses.kjv: [As] God liveth, [who] hath taken away my judgment; and the Almighty, [who] hath vexed my soul;
verses.web: “As God lives, who has taken away my right, the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter
verses.he: חַי־אֵ֭ל הֵסִ֣יר מִשְׁפָּטִ֑י וְ֝שַׁדַּ֗י הֵמַ֥ר נַפְשִֽׁי׃

verses.ar: إِنَّهُ مَا دَامَتْ نَسَمَتِي فِيَّ، وَنَفْخَةُ ٱللهِ فِي أَنْفِي،
verses.kjv: All the while my breath [is] in me, and the spirit of God [is] in my nostrils;
verses.web: (for the length of my life is still in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils);
verses.he: כִּֽי־כָל־עֹ֣וד נִשְׁמָתִ֣י בִ֑י וְר֖וּחַ אֱלֹ֣והַּ בְּאַפִּֽי׃

verses.ar: لَنْ تَتَكَلَّمَ شَفَتَايَ إِثْمًا، وَلَا يَلْفِظَ لِسَانِي بِغِشٍّ.
verses.kjv: My lips shall not speak wickedness, nor my tongue utter deceit.
verses.web: surely my lips will not speak unrighteousness, neither will my tongue utter deceit.
verses.he: אִם־תְּדַבֵּ֣רְנָה שְׂפָתַ֣י עַוְלָ֑ה וּ֝לְשֹׁונִ֗י אִם־יֶהְגֶּ֥ה רְמִיָּֽה׃

verses.ar: حَاشَا لِي أَنْ أُبَرِّرَكُمْ! حَتَّى أُسْلِمَ ٱلرُّوحَ لَا أَعْزِلُ كَمَالِي عَنِّي.
verses.kjv: God forbid that I should justify you: till I die I will not remove mine integrity from me.
verses.web: Far be it from me that I should justify you. Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me.
verses.he: חָלִ֣ילָה לִּי֮ אִם־אַצְדִּ֪יק אֶ֫תְכֶ֥ם עַד־אֶגְוָ֑ע לֹא־אָסִ֖יר תֻּמָּתִ֣י מִמֶּֽנִּי׃

verses.ar: تَمَسَّكْتُ بِبِرِّي وَلَا أَرْخِيهِ. قَلْبِي لَا يُعَيِّرُ يَوْمًا مِنْ أَيَّامِي.
verses.kjv: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: my heart shall not reproach [me] so long as I live.
verses.web: I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go. My heart will not reproach me so long as I live.
verses.he: בְּצִדְקָתִ֣י הֶ֭חֱזַקְתִּי וְלֹ֣א אַרְפֶּ֑הָ לֹֽא־יֶחֱרַ֥ף לְ֝בָבִ֗י מִיָּמָֽי׃

verses.ar: لِيَكُنْ عَدُوِّي كَٱلشِّرِّيرِ، وَمُعَانِدِي كَفَاعِلِ ٱلشَّرِّ.
verses.kjv: Let mine enemy be as the wicked, and he that riseth up against me as the unrighteous.
verses.web: “Let my enemy be as the wicked. Let him who rises up against me be as the unrighteous.
verses.he: יְהִ֣י כְ֭רָשָׁע אֹ֣יְבִ֑י וּמִתְקֹומְמִ֥י כְעַוָּֽל׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ مَا هُوَ رَجَاءُ ٱلْفَاجِرِ عِنْدَمَا يَقْطَعُهُ، عِنْدَمَا يَسْلُبُ ٱللهُ نَفْسَهُ؟
verses.kjv: For what [is] the hope of the hypocrite, though he hath gained, when God taketh away his soul?
verses.web: For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?
verses.he: כִּ֤י מַה־תִּקְוַ֣ת חָ֭נֵף כִּ֣י יִבְצָ֑ע כִּ֤י יֵ֖שֶׁל אֱלֹ֣והַּ נַפְשֹֽׁו׃

verses.ar: أَفَيَسْمَعُ ٱللهُ صُرَاخَهُ إِذَا جَاءَ عَلَيْهِ ضِيقٌ؟
verses.kjv: Will God hear his cry when trouble cometh upon him?
verses.web: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?
verses.he: הַֽ֭צַעֲקָתֹו יִשְׁמַ֥ע ׀ אֵ֑ל כִּֽי־תָבֹ֖וא עָלָ֣יו צָרָֽה׃

verses.ar: أَمْ يَتَلَذَّذُ بِٱلْقَدِيرِ؟ هَلْ يَدْعُو ٱللهَ فِي كُلِّ حِينٍ؟
verses.kjv: Will he delight himself in the Almighty? will he always call upon God?
verses.web: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on God at all times?
verses.he: אִם־עַל־שַׁדַּ֥י יִתְעַנָּ֑ג יִקְרָ֖א אֱלֹ֣והַּ בְּכָל־עֵֽת׃

verses.ar: «إِنِّي أُعَلِّمُكُمْ بِيَدِ ٱللهِ. لَا أَكْتُمُ مَا هُوَ عِنْدَ ٱلْقَدِيرِ.
verses.kjv: I will teach you by the hand of God: [that] which [is] with the Almighty will I not conceal.
verses.web: I will teach you about the hand of God. I will not conceal that which is with the Almighty.
verses.he: אֹורֶ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֣ם בְּיַד־אֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עִם־שַׁ֝דַּ֗י לֹ֣א אֲכַחֵֽד׃

verses.ar: هَا أَنْتُمْ كُلُّكُمْ قَدْ رَأَيْتُمْ، فَلِمَاذَا تَتَبَطَّلُونَ تَبَطُّلًا؟ قَائِلِينَ:
verses.kjv: Behold, all ye yourselves have seen [it;] why then are ye thus altogether vain?
verses.web: Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves; why then have you become altogether vain?
verses.he: הֵן־אַתֶּ֣ם כֻּלְּכֶ֣ם חֲזִיתֶ֑ם וְלָמָּה־זֶּ֝֗ה הֶ֣בֶל תֶּהְבָּֽלוּ׃

verses.ar: هَذَا نَصِيبُ ٱلْإِنْسَانِ ٱلشِّرِّيرِ مِنْ عِنْدِ ٱللهِ، وَمِيرَاثُ ٱلْعُتَاةِ ٱلَّذِي يَنَالُونَهُ مِنَ ٱلْقَدِيرِ.
verses.kjv: This [is] the portion of a wicked man with God, and the heritage of oppressors, [which] they shall receive of the Almighty.
verses.web: “This is the portion of a wicked man with God, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.
verses.he: זֶ֤ה ׀ חֵֽלֶק־אָדָ֖ם רָשָׁ֥ע ׀ עִם־אֵ֑ל וְֽנַחֲלַ֥ת עָ֝רִיצִ֗ים מִשַּׁדַּ֥י יִקָּֽחוּ׃

verses.ar: إِنْ كَثُرَ بَنُوهُ فَلِلسَّيْفِ، وَذُرِّيَّتُهُ لَا تَشْبَعُ خُبْزًا.
verses.kjv: If his children be multiplied, [it is] for the sword: and his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.
verses.web: If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring will not be satisfied with bread.
verses.he: אִם־יִרְבּ֣וּ בָנָ֣יו לְמֹו־חָ֑רֶב וְ֝צֶאֱצָאָ֗יו לֹ֣א יִשְׂבְּעוּ־לָֽחֶם׃

verses.ar: بَقِيَّتُهُ تُدْفَنُ بِٱلْمَوْتَانِ، وَأَرَامِلُهُ لَا تَبْكِي.
verses.kjv: Those that remain of him shall be buried in death: and his widows shall not weep.
verses.web: Those who remain of him will be buried in death. His widows will make no lamentation.
verses.he: *שְׂרִידֹו (שְׂ֭רִידָיו) בַּמָּ֣וֶת יִקָּבֵ֑רוּ וְ֝אַלְמְנֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִבְכֶּֽינָה׃

verses.ar: إِنْ كَنَزَ فِضَّةً كَٱلتُّرَابِ، وَأَعَدَّ مَلَابِسَ كَٱلطِّينِ،
verses.kjv: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare raiment as the clay;
verses.web: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;
verses.he: אִם־יִצְבֹּ֣ר כֶּעָפָ֣ר כָּ֑סֶף וְ֝כַחֹ֗מֶר יָכִ֥ין מַלְבּֽוּשׁ׃

verses.ar: فَهُوَ يُعِدُّ وَٱلْبَارُّ يَلْبَسُهُ، وَٱلْبَرِئُ يَقْسِمُ ٱلْفِضَّةَ.
verses.kjv: He may prepare [it], but the just shall put [it] on, and the innocent shall divide the silver.
verses.web: he may prepare it, but the just will put it on, and the innocent will divide the silver.
verses.he: יָ֭כִין וְצַדִּ֣יק יִלְבָּ֑שׁ וְ֝כֶ֗סֶף נָקִ֥י יַחֲלֹֽק׃

verses.ar: يَبْنِي بَيْتَهُ كَٱلْعُثِّ، أَوْ كَمَظَلَّةٍ صَنَعَهَا ٱلنَّاطُورُ.
verses.kjv: He buildeth his house as a moth, and as a booth [that] the keeper maketh.
verses.web: He builds his house as the moth, as a booth which the watchman makes.
verses.he: בָּנָ֣ה כָעָ֣שׁ בֵּיתֹ֑ו וּ֝כְסֻכָּ֗ה עָשָׂ֥ה נֹצֵֽר׃

verses.ar: يَضْطَجِعُ غَنِيًّا وَلَكِنَّهُ لَا يُضَمُّ. يَفْتَحُ عَيْنَيْهِ وَلَا يَكُونُ.
verses.kjv: The rich man shall lie down, but he shall not be gathered: he openeth his eyes, and he [is] not.
verses.web: He lies down rich, but he will not do so again. He opens his eyes, and he is not.
verses.he: עָשִׁ֣יר יִ֭שְׁכַּב וְלֹ֣א יֵאָסֵ֑ף עֵינָ֖יו פָּקַ֣ח וְאֵינֶֽנּוּ׃

verses.ar: ٱلْأَهْوَالُ تُدْرِكُهُ كَٱلْمِيَاهِ. لَيْلًا تَخْتَطِفُهُ ٱلزَّوْبَعَةُ.
verses.kjv: Terrors take hold on him as waters, a tempest stealeth him away in the night.
verses.web: Terrors overtake him like waters. A storm steals him away in the night.
verses.he: תַּשִּׂיגֵ֣הוּ כַ֭מַּיִם בַּלָּהֹ֑ות לַ֝֗יְלָה גְּנָבַ֥תּוּ סוּפָֽה׃

verses.ar: تَحْمِلُهُ ٱلشَّرْقِيَّةُ فَيَذْهَبُ، وَتَجْرُفُهُ مِنْ مَكَانِهِ.
verses.kjv: The east wind carrieth him away, and he departeth: and as a storm hurleth him out of his place.
verses.web: The east wind carries him away, and he departs. It sweeps him out of his place.
verses.he: יִשָּׂאֵ֣הוּ קָדִ֣ים וְיֵלַ֑ךְ וִֽ֝ישָׂעֲרֵ֗הוּ מִמְּקֹמֹֽו׃

verses.ar: يُلْقِي ٱللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَلَا يُشْفِقُ. مِنْ يَدِهِ يَهْرُبُ هَرَبًا.
verses.kjv: For [God] shall cast upon him, and not spare: he would fain flee out of his hand.
verses.web: For it hurls at him, and does not spare, as he flees away from his hand.
verses.he: וְיַשְׁלֵ֣ךְ עָ֭לָיו וְלֹ֣א יַחְמֹ֑ל מִ֝יָּדֹ֗ו בָּרֹ֥וחַ יִבְרָֽח׃

verses.ar: يَصْفِقُونَ عَلَيْهِ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ، وَيَصْفِرُونَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ مَكَانِهِ.
verses.kjv: [Men] shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.
verses.web: Men will clap their hands at him, and will hiss him out of his place.
verses.he: יִשְׂפֹּ֣ק עָלֵ֣ימֹו כַפֵּ֑ימֹו וְיִשְׁרֹ֥ק עָ֝לָ֗יו מִמְּקֹמֹֽו׃
